findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hardcoded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables, exposing long-term credentials to anyone with read access to the Terraform code or Lambda configuration/console/API.

The Lambda function does not specify a KMS key (kms_key_arn) to encrypt environment variables at rest, so sensitive data such as the embedded credentials is only protected by default AWS-managed encryption rather than a customer-managed key, weakening control over access to the secrets.
